selection: Use exactly source_gate == comparatively_clear_under_README. Independently equivalent to knowledge_code == 0, or knowledge_code == 3 with unequal left/right counts. No outcome or model-score selection.
scoring: Reuse original probabilities and labels. Clip probabilities at 1e-9 and 1-1e-9 for loss calculation. Equal total weight per condition for NLL/Brier. Accuracy uses p_left >= 0.5 as left, same as historical evaluation.
tie_diagnostic: Supplementary expected accuracy giving 0.5 correctness to each exactly tied p_left=0.5 prediction, without changing the main accuracy rule or choosing the better rule.
empirical_probability_errors: Compare one shared condition probability to the observed condition left fraction. Fractions have sampling uncertainty and are not known population probabilities.
training_caveat: Only the scored subset is filtered. Existing frequency/rule/Logit models are not refit. Their original training folds include direction-map and balanced-equal-map records outside this subset; disclose these counts for each retained fold.
development_visibility: Overall results and some subgroup results were already inspected. This is a source-based sensitivity check, not pre-registered confirmation, an unseen test, or 246 new independent LLM requests.
interpretation: If NLL and Brier do not both improve over frequency, this fixed predictor's failure persists in relatively clear contexts. Do not claim all failure comes from map codes 1/2. Any positive subgroup result remains exploratory, without selecting a new prompt.
invalid_cache_policy: Stop on missing, duplicate, invalid or hash-mismatched cache rows; no model calls or substitute predictions.
